newsitem.title: UK: Glaxo says ex-Zantac sales up 14 percent.
newsitem.headline: Glaxo says ex-Zantac sales up 14 percent.

text.p: British drugs group Glaxo Wellcome Plc said on Thursday that sales excluding ulcer treatment Zantac rose by 14 percent in the first half of the year at constant exchange rates.
Including Zantac, which has lost its patent in the U.S. but has not yet faced competition there, sales were up by an underlying 8 percent.
Glaxo Wellcome said sales of newer products introduced since 1990 rose by 50 percent to 1.3 billion stg, and "now comfortably exceed those of Zantac".

The company said sterling's strength had a significant effect on reported operating profits and sales, which rose by six percent and eight percent respectively at constant exchange rates but were down three percent and two percent in headline terms.
